rationale: Plan directly addresses the task objective by: (1) loading the medical claims data, (2) ranking denial codes among denied claims and quantifying missing codes by status to answer which codes are most common and how many claims lack codes, (3) analyzing denial rates across all five requested segments (claim type, provider specialty, network status, place of service, auth requirement) with flagging of small groups per the task tags, and (4) writing a report with denominators and artifact citations for transparency and reproducibility.
